valid_supported: Finite bounded page boxes and six-operand item/glyph transforms, including valid tiny and adjacent values.
malformed: Nonfinite, reversed or unnested boxes and matrices outside the stated input policy.
existing_unsupported: Arbitrary operators and unbounded coordinate inputs.

native.predicate: Check finite positive boxes; validate nesting before output.

independent.predicate: Decode each actual page box and check the independently authored coordinates and nesting.

native.predicate: Check source matrix policy without blanket underflow rejection.

emitter.invariant: Encode exact binary32 decimal operands where compact tokens lose the supported determinant relation.

independent.predicate: Use actual number spellings and Fraction determinants; distinguish permitted receiver underflow.

valid_supported: Moves, lines, cubics and closure; both fill rules; every line cap/join, admitted dash and color/alpha form.
malformed: Bad ordering, missing initial move, invalid finite/range paint or stroke operands.
existing_unsupported: Gradient strokes and arbitrary operator insertion.

native.predicate: Validate width, cap/join parameters, miter and dash relationships.

emitter.invariant: Preserve supplied path, fill/stroke ordering and clipping.

independent.predicate: Decode path commands and the independently authored nine cap/join combinations.

valid_supported: Decoded eight-bit RGB, Gray or CMYK planes with optional straight alpha; all registered resources are emitted.
malformed: Wrong products/planes, invalid dimensions, missing requested alpha, duplicate identities or resource budget failures.
existing_unsupported: Encoded image ingestion through the neutral constructors.

native.predicate: Checked dimensions/planes and shared lifetime admission; sibling RGB/Gray constructors use the same contract.

emitter.invariant: Preserve exact samples and matching Gray alpha planes.

independent.predicate: Independently decode every image, including unused objects, and compare with authored planes.

valid_supported: Exact supported TrueType subsets and rights-required untouched full programs, including retained component closures.
malformed: Malformed retained tables, coordinates, component correspondence or program framing.
existing_unsupported: Full collection embedding and arbitrary nondefault variation instances.

preconditions.statement: Version1 language tags have their declared registry/extension meaning. Genuinely uninterpreted platform metadata has its declared encoding/context. Family aliases use mandatory Unicode or the published default MacRoman mapping; exact historical variant spelling needs its actual context or a usable Unicode alias. Mandatory Unicode bytes, container/index/order checks and selected PostScript identity legality remain checked; other permitted PostScript identity records are explicitly ignored for identity.

native.predicate: Validate exact retained structures, component indices, metrics and cache semantics.

emitter.invariant: Embed the exact prepared FontFile2 and CID widths.

valid_supported: Supported CFF1 subsets, flex operations and full affine Top/FD matrices, including default initialization and valid decimal coordinates.

valid_supported: Confined exact-byte font preparation with separate ascent and capital-height authority and source/face-bound optional author facts.
malformed: Changed source/report/worker identities, malformed facts, conflicting computable facts or missing required print authority.
existing_unsupported: Inspection success as a substitute for preparation or an arbitrary font VM theorem.

preconditions.statement: An explicit accent set truthfully and completely classifies retained source roles, including component tails and untouched full programs. Identity/range/completeness framing is checked; semantic truth is supplied by the resource author.

A supplied unresolved capital height is the truthful source/face design value in final PDF glyph units. Missing differs from explicit zero; a fact cannot override an independently computable conflicting metric.

native.predicate: Bind exact source/face/GIDs, worker/rules, final program and independently scoped fact identities.

emitter.invariant: Keep exact prepared bytes; rights-required full output equals complete source.

independent.predicate: Reconstruct independent source correspondence, ordered component closure and exact program identity.

native.predicate: Compute geometry-based facts and preserve unresolved authority; truthful optional facts fill only unresolved roles/metrics.

emitter.invariant: Require ascent and capital authority for all registered print fonts, including unused ones.

independent.predicate: Use source geometry plus separately authored fact inputs; calculate expected ascent/capital metrics independently.

independent.predicate: Decode independent ToUnicode mappings and ActualText strings through the separately hashed text helper, retaining actual encoded string limits.

malformed: Invalid timestamps, blank print title, bad/duplicate resource IDs or excessive aggregate text.

independent.predicate: Independently decode Info/XMP title and normalized dates.

existing_unsupported: Other output profile roles and unsupported editions.

Any profile adaptation/measurement declaration truthfully describes its original measurement and required interpretation context.

Present characterization interchange files or registered references satisfy their declared format/reference; present legacy PostScript payloads supply the required valid operand and intent relationships. Native framing checks do not execute these nested languages.
